## Period lines (#4): options and costs

The only source found with historical period and team-total lines is The Odds API
[@odds_api]. Its market keys include `spreads_h1`, `totals_q1` … `q4`, and
`team_totals_h1`. Historical data for these "additional markets" starts on **May 3,
2023** and requires a paid plan.

| Option | Cost | Gives |
|---|---|---|
| History, one month of the 5M-credit plan | $119 once | 2023–2025 seasons: about 2,400 games × 15 markets × 10 credits ≈ 360K credits for one snapshot per game |
| Forward only, 20K-credit plan | $30/month | Weekly capture from now on (about 900 credits/week) |
| Free plan (500 credits/month) | $0 | Not enough for weekly capture |

: Options for period lines. {#tbl-odds}

One unknown: how many college games actually get quarter lines. Books tend to post them
only for bigger games. That would be checked on the first pull.

## Should this become a website?

This book renders as both a PDF and a website from the same source. Publishing the HTML
version on GitHub Pages costs nothing extra. The next useful step would be a small page
that shows the weekly card and the running paper record, updated by the same weekly
Action.
